retention.title: Retention
retention.savedOff: Retention is off; articles won’t be cleaned up.
retention.daysInvalid: Days to keep must be a whole number greater than 0.
retention.keepOnHint_one: Articles saved for 1 day lose their text, vectors, translations, and images, keeping only the title, link, and reading history.

retention.keepOffHint: When off, no articles are cleaned up. When on, age is counted from when the article was saved; on the feed page you can set a different period for one feed or keep it forever.
retention.daysHint: Counted from when the article was saved.
retention.customFeeds_one: 1 feed has its own retention setting.
retention.customFeeds_other: {{count}} feeds have their own retention settings.
retention.protectedA: Never cleaned up: starred articles, articles cited in chats, and articles used as digest sources.
retention.protectedB: Unread articles are cleaned up too; after cleanup they can still be found by title, and the text is re-fetched when you open them.
